title: Layer 1: Hormuz Direct Indicators
title_zh: 第一层：霍尔木兹直射指标
desc: Core variables driving the entire chain
desc_zh: 所有逻辑链的第一推动力

warRiskPremium.note: PREMIUM SPIKING: Doha diplomatic track collapsed. Khamenei funeral period (Jul 4-6) shifted Iran posture under Mojtaba Khamenei. Jul 7: Tanker attacks resume in Hormuz. Jul 8: Trump threatens to bomb Iran. Jul 9: Tanker traffic slows, mediators scramble. Jul 10: Analysis confirms deal failure. Jul 11: IRGC declares Strait closed, Trump threatens to 'decimate' Iran (CNBC). Jul 12: US launches fresh strikes after Cyprus-flagged vessel attack. Iran says Strait of Hormuz closed 'until further notice' (BBC, Jul 12). War risk premiums spiking sharply from the ~3-8x level to an estimated 8-15x as fighting resumes. Updated 2026-07-12
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 保费飙升：多哈外交轨道崩溃。哈梅内伊葬礼期间（7月4-6日）穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊改变伊朗姿态。7月7日：油轮在霍尔木兹遭攻击。7月8日：特朗普威胁轰炸伊朗。7月9日：油轮运输放缓。7月10日：分析确认协议破裂。7月11日：IRGC宣布海峡关闭，特朗普威胁'摧毁'伊朗。7月12日：美国发动新一轮打击。伊朗称海峡'直至另行通知前'关闭。战争险保费从3-8倍水平急剧飙升至8-15倍。更新于 2026-07-12

straitThroughput.value_zh: 约0-1桶/天 | 关闭——美军打击中
straitThroughput.note: STRAIT CLOSED: Diplomatic track completely collapsed. Jul 7: Attacks on tankers in Strait. US revokes Iran oil sales authorization (CNBC, Jul 7). Jul 8: Trump threatens to bomb Iran and reimpose naval blockade. Jul 9: Tanker traffic slows significantly (CNBC, Jul 9). Jul 10: IEA says world oil demand faces first annual decline since 2020. Jul 11: IRGC declares Strait of Hormuz closed; Trump threatens to 'decimate' Iran. Jul 12: US launches fresh strikes after Cyprus-flagged vessel attack; Iran says Strait closed 'until further notice' (BBC, Al Jazeera, CNBC multiple sources). Throughput effectively near zero for commercial traffic. Oil prices volatile with supply disruption risk. Updated 2026-07-12
straitThroughput.note_zh: 海峡关闭：外交轨道完全崩溃。7月7日：油轮遭攻击，美国撤销伊朗石油销售授权。7月8日：特朗普威胁轰炸伊朗。7月9日：油轮运输显著放缓。7月10日：IEA称全球石油需求将面临2020年以来首次年度下降。7月11日：IRGC宣布海峡关闭，特朗普威胁'摧毁'伊朗。7月12日：美军发动新一轮打击；伊朗称海峡'直至另行通知前'关闭。商业通行量实际为零。油价受供应中断风险影响剧烈波动。更新于 2026-07-12

irgcStatementFreq.note: IRGC statement frequency spiked to crisis levels as hostilities resumed. Mojtaba Khamenei consolidated as new Supreme Leader. Jul 11: IRGC formally declares Strait of Hormuz closed. Jul 10-12: Multiple IRGC statements threatening US and allies. Iran's top negotiator continues Omani FM talks (Al Jazeera, Jul 11) but military posture hardened. Warning shot fired at Cyprus-flagged vessel (BBC, Jul 12). Revenge rhetoric from funeral period now translated into military action. Updated 2026-07-12
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: IRGC声明频率随冲突重启升至危机水平。穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊巩固为新最高领袖。7月11日：IRGC正式宣布海峡关闭。7月10-12日：多次IRGC声明威胁美国及盟友。伊朗首席谈判代表仍在与阿曼外长会谈（AJ，7月11日）但军事姿态强硬。向塞浦路斯旗船只鸣枪警告（BBC，7月12日）。葬礼期间的复仇言论已转化为军事行动。更新于 2026-07-12

fleetPosition.value: Active combat operations resumed — fresh strikes Jul 12
fleetPosition.value_zh: 实战行动恢复——7月12日新一轮打击
fleetPosition.note: COMPLETE PHASE REVERSAL: US 5th fleet transitioned back to active combat ops. Jul 7: Iran-backed tanker attacks in Hormuz. US revokes Iran oil sales authorization. Jul 8: Trump threatens to bomb Iran. Jul 9: Tanker traffic slows under threat. Jul 10: Mediators scramble to contain escalation (CNBC). Jul 11: IRGC declares Strait closed. Jul 12: US launches fresh strikes on Iran after Cyprus-flagged vessel attacked. CENTCOM posture is aggressive. Diplomatic window from Doha talks (Jul 2-3) fully closed. Strike operations are now the primary posture. Updated 2026-07-12
fleetPosition.note_zh: 完全反转：美第5舰队回到实战行动。7月7日：伊朗支持攻击霍尔木兹油轮，美国撤销伊朗石油销售授权。7月8日：特朗普威胁轰炸伊朗。7月9日：油轮运输放缓。7月10日：调解者紧急控制升级。7月11日：IRGC宣布海峡关闭。7月12日：美军对伊朗发动新一轮打击。CENTCOM姿态激进。多哈会谈（7月2-3日）的外交窗口完全关闭。打击行动为当前主要姿态。更新于 2026-07-12

saudiUaeStance.value: Saudi and GCC in crisis — diplomacy collapsed, security threat elevated
saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 沙特及GCC陷入危机——外交崩溃，安全威胁升级
saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: GCC POSITION CRITICAL: Oman's fee plan for Strait transit rendered moot as hostilities resumed. Jul 7-12: Tanker attacks and US strikes collapse the Doha diplomatic framework. Saudi faces direct security threat as Hormuz closure impacts Saudi oil exports via alternative routes (Yanbu pipeline). MBS stayed in Saudi throughout. OPEC+ production policy in turmoil. Hajj 2026 security managed but region destabilized. Saudi may seek independent security arrangements as US-Iran tit-for-tat escalates. Iran envoy to China claims Beijing will get Hormuz concessions — potential China role emerging. Updated 2026-07-12
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: GCC立场危急：阿曼海峡通行费方案因冲突重启而失效。沙特面临直接安全威胁——海峡关闭影响沙特经替代路线（延布管道）的石油出口。MBS留守沙特。OPEC+产量政策陷入混乱。朝觐安全可控但地区动荡。美伊报复升级中沙特或寻求独立安全安排。伊朗驻华大使称北京将获海峡权益——中国角色可能浮现。更新于 2026-07-12
